title: Thai-Style Twice-Fried Potato Fritters
description: A crispy and flavorful snack inspired by Thai street food. Twice-frying the fritters gives them a crunchy exterior and fluffy interior.
instructions: Grate the light potatoes, peruvian gold potatoes, and yukon potatoes.
Squeeze out as much moisture as possible from the grated potatoes.
In a bowl, mix together the grated potatoes, 1 egg, and 1/4 cup of flour.
Heat about 1-2 inches of oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the potato mixture into the oil.
Fry the fritters until they are golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
Remove the fritters from the oil and let them cool on a paper towel-lined plate.
Increase the heat to high and add more oil to the pan if necessary.
Once the oil is hot, add the fritters back into the pan and fry until they are crispy and golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
